verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents its own testing capability: a built-in simulated card reader in the SDKs and server-driven integration, so you can develop and test without physical hardware. The evidence does not explicitly describe a separate sandbox or test-mode environment that keeps test data apart from production; it describes hardware simulation, not data isolation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox/test-mode environment isolated from production data, test card/credential details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.
Before ordering a reader, test your integration with the reader simulator.
